title: SEA — Same-Tx Spot Quote Redemption Analysis
root_cause: SEA redemption/burn mechanism reads the SEA/USDT AMM spot quote within the same transaction. Attacker executes 60 swaps on the pair to inflate the spot SEA price, then burns SEA tokens at the inflated rate to redeem USDT from the protocol treasury, extracting ~$153K profit.
steps: - Each swap emits 1 `Swap` + 1 `Sync` (→ 60+60 in the log)
- Net effect: `reserve1(USDT)` depleted, `reserve0(SEA)` inflated → `SEA price in USDT` increases
424 Transfer events = flash loan (×2) + 60 swap internal transfers (×2 directions, ~120) + seaAmount burn transfers + usdtOut treasury transfer + fee accruals + profit routing.
